## About
F and H Tire Pomona is a tire shop and mechanic on Holt in Pomona, serving drivers from Pomona, Ontario, Chino and the surrounding areas. We handle tires, wheels, alignments and everyday repairs for passenger cars, medium sized trucks and mini-vans.
Customers mention Omar by name, and one reviewer describes him as the young local owner. People tell us they appreciate getting in and out quickly, fair prices and friendly help at the counter.
Need tires on a weekend? We are open Saturday and Sunday too. Stop by during business hours or send us a service request and we will set up a time that works for you.

## Services
- Tire installation and repair: New tires installed, flats repaired, tires rotated and wheels balanced.
- Tesla tire installation and repair: Tire installation and repair for Tesla owners.
- Wheel alignment: We adjust your wheels so they line up the way they should, which helps your car track straight.
- TPMS service: Tire pressure monitoring system repair and installation.
- Brake repair: Brake inspections, rotor replacement, front disc brake repair and parking brake adjustment.
- Steering and suspension: Ball joints, tie rods, shocks and struts for a comfortable ride.
- Oil and filter change: Routine oil and filter changes to keep your engine running well.
- Mobile service: Our mobile technicians can come to you for tire work instead of you coming to the shop.
- Roadside assistance: Help when you are stranded, including flat tire repair, jump starts, fuel service and lockouts.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Yes. We are open Sunday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

Q: Can I schedule a service ahead of time?
A: Yes. Send a service request through our website and we will get back to you within 24 hours to set a time that works for you.

Q: Can I wait while you work on my car?
A: Yes. When you request service you can choose to wait for your vehicle or leave it with us.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Pomona, Ontario, Chino and the surrounding areas.
